# 💡 The Swordsman Process
**concept** · swordsman · knowledge

Separate deterministic signing service described by AgentPrivacy MCP. It checks key content, holder identity, lineage and policy before emitting a signed VTA record. No live signer was provisioned or exercised by this graph update.
